kind: Browser fixtures for explicit final-universality requirements

rows.name: Shared links preserve mixed text, repeated parameters and mail targets, reject credentials, and disclose destinations without secrets
External link rendering adds the actual destination to cloned links without changing the native source
Real label preview restores before/after state and diagnostics find differing selectors on the same element and low contrast
Placement preview moves original nodes reversibly, preserves handlers, ignores missing targets and refuses a parent inside its own child
Formatting preview and restoration keep native descendants, handlers and content added after preview
Batch transfer retry prepares only distinct failures and their destination without submitting another transfer
Long predefined lists search accents, retain duplicates and explain append/replace without changing text during filtering
Efficiency follows pagination without total, labels partial results and retries without discarding available values
Report print preserves native rows, prints only visible content and declares loaded-row scope with repeated headers
Configured navigation rejects active URLs and credentials, previews query parameters and restores the native description
Input rules defer composed text, sanitize paste and keep a UTF-16 caret after emoji without changing valid accents
Contact requirements combine groups, focus the invalid field and include fields added dynamically without dropping native help
